definition: [ מְלַח ] verb denominative with accusative of congnate meaning with verb, eat salt ; — Pe`al Perfect 1 plural מְלַחְנָא Ezra 4:14 we have eaten the salt of the palace (so most), i.e. have assumed obligations of loyalty, compare M 69* K § 71, 2 (and Syriac be intimate with PS 2134 ); Str (after Nes MM 30 f. ) thinks noun with suffix: our salt is the salt of the palace.
